{
  "name": "virtual-garden",
  "displayName": "Virtual Garden",
  "version": "1.0.0",
  "description": "A mindful ASCII garden above the prompt that grows with green AI habits: prompt caching, lean context and /compact.",
  "author": {
    "name": "Leon Lourenço Gomes"
  },
  "homepage": "https://github.com/leon-lourenco/green-ai/tree/main/plugins/virtual-garden",
  "repository": "https://github.com/leon-lourenco/green-ai",
  "license": "MIT",
  "types": "./types/index.d.ts",
  "keywords": [
    "garden",
    "gamification",
    "ascii",
    "sustainability",
    "eco",
    "cache",
    "awareness"
  ],
  "userConfig": {
    "format": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Display format",
      "description": "short: one line above the prompt. full: the whole garden with stats and a tip. off: keep growing without showing it.",
      "options": [
        "short",
        "full",
        "off"
      ],
      "default": "short"
    },
    "species": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Plant",
      "description": "The plant to tend. current keeps the one you are growing; a locked species shows how to unlock it.",
      "options": [
        "current",
        "bonsai",
        "cactus",
        "sakura",
        "ipe"
      ],
      "default": "current"
    },
    "language": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Language",
      "description": "Defaults to automatic detection.",
      "options": [
        "auto",
        "en",
        "pt"
      ],
      "default": "auto"
    }
  }
}
